ATLAS is a comprehensive mobile platform for professional penetration testers using the Mayweather ecosystem.

It covers all aspects of an audit including pre-audit OSINT, mapping, scope and authorisation certificates. During an audit, ATLAS manages real-time device management: credential collection from deployed Doppelgänger Core or Stealth units.

Deep integration with the Proxmark3 RDV4 and MSRX6-BLE enable rapid credential simulation and cloning, allowing for fluid access escalation.

ATLAS is the official Mayweather Group platform, with active development, on-device encrypted storage, and direct vendor support.

This is a 1-Year Standard Licence for ATLAS. Activation codes will be issued by email immediately after purchase.

NO GAP AUDITING

ATLAS covers the full audit life-cycle: pre-audit, intelligence, escalation, collaboration, documentation and reporting.

FIELD-FIRST FOCUS

Real-time alerts of captured credentials across all devices. Wireless cloning of captured RFID and magstripe cards.

TEAM-AWARE

Real time, on & off-site collaboration with teams and team members. Capture and data from multiple devices instantly to team members.

UNITE YOUR TOOLS

ATLAS marries all Mayweather hardware (credential capture & sniffing) with industry-standard tools for RFID and Magstripe writing. Although you've always got access to a terminal - everything is UI driven. No need to remember exotic proxmark CLI commands in the heat of the moment, no need for a laptop and cables. ATLAS abstracts complex, time-consuming and domain-specific tasks to allow you to concentrate on rapid auditing, penetration and escalation. It provides deep integration of the following tools:

  • Doppelgänger Stealth: Decoy reader. Captures badges and PINs. Mount it, walk away, recover later. Stealth filtering hides your activity.
  • Doppelgänger Core: Longrange WiFi reader. Reads cards from 2 feet plus, with real-time streaming into ATLAS.
  • Proxmark3 RDV4 + Blueshark: Native Bluetooth control. Full Proxmark3 toolset, no laptop required.
  • MSRX6-BLE: Magstripe read, write and analysis over Bluetooth LE.

WHO IT'S FOR

RED TEAMS

Import SOWs and LOAs, build reference graphics, conduct threat profiling, clone access cards, and export to SPEAR for reporting.

PSD ADVANCE TEAMS

Document entry points, camera positions and guard patterns. Push situational awareness to TAK before the principal arrives.

SECURITY LEADERS

Review GPS-tagged findings, audit third-party assessments, track project completion, and maintain compliance documentation.

LAW ENFORCEMENT

Support undercover operations with AES-256 local storage, offline license validation, and evidence export with chain-of-custody timestamps.

FOUNDED ON SECURITY

Optimised for Graphene OS. No root required. Everything kept locally with hardware-backed AES-256 encryption. No cloud sync. No telemetry. Your engagement stays on your device. See the ATLAS Security Pledge for more information.

Software Specifications

  • Platform: Android 8.0 or higher (Pixel with GrapheneOS recommended)
  • Current Version: 1.1.0

  • Connectivity: Bluetooth, Bluetooth LE, Network

What's Included

Frequently Asked Questions

Do I need a laptop to use ATLAS?

No. ATLAS runs entirely on your Android device. Proxmark3, Stealth, Core and MSRX6-BLE all pair over Bluetooth or network.

What hardware do I actually need?

Only the Android device is required. Hardware is added based on the engagement: Proxmark3 RDV4 with Blueshark for LF and HF operations, MSRX6-BLE for magstripe, Doppelgänger Core or Stealth for longrange and decoy work.

Is my data sent to the cloud?

No. Operational data stays on the device, encrypted at rest with hardware-backed AES-256. No telemetry, no sync, no transmission.

Can I try it before I buy?

Yes. The 3-day free trial unlocks the full feature set. After that, the Standard License is annual and binds to a single device.

Is there a Government or Enterprise version?

Yes. Offline license validation, custom features and volume pricing are available. Contact support@lab401.com.

Extracting RFID & Keypad credentials via spliced implants is a well-known technique. However, these tools are rarely used in professional audits: installations are slow and complicated, and damage to wiring, hardware and infrastructure are rarely authorised in Scope of Engagement documents.

The implants themselves have limited functionality and protocol support, and only provide the "capture" part of an RFID Audit lifecycle. The analysis and cloning of a captured credential requires multiple manual steps, tools and skills.

Imagine walking into an audit, placing an access control reader on a wall and instantly collecting credentials. Your phone gives you real-time notifications of skimmed badges and PIN codes, and directly writes a clone badge with your Proxmark.

You don't need a computer, you don't need to damage client property, you don't need to memorise arcane Proxmark commands. Everything is taken care of. When the audit is over, you've got a timestamped log of all operations, ready for export into a report. Your time and skills are spent on the audit, instead of the tools.

You've just imagined the Stealth Decoy Reader platform, a next-generation, non-destructive credential capture system designed specifically for red-teamers and pentesters. Even better, the Stealth Decoy Reader is available pre-installed inside the most common access control readers for perfect camouflage. The readers come equipped with non-destructive mounting systems, ready for rapid placement in public areas, choke points, doorways, cabinets, etc.
